description: Weekly dependency updates. Minor and patch npm updates arrive as one PR; majors one by one.

The Renovate app's own config watches only GitHub Actions unless enabledManagers names the rest (#43), and leaves lock files alone unless skipArtifactsUpdate is false, so an npm update would move package.json without package-lock.json.

packageRules.description: Types follow the Node.js version in engines, not the newest Node.js.

Keep the digest-pinned base image current, but move to the next Node.js LTS on purpose: the base image, the workflows' node-version and the CI matrix together, engines when the oldest supported LTS goes.
